import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        // compute vn first
        int vn = enc(n-1, n-1, m, n) + 1;
        ArrayList<HashMap<Integer, Integer>> edges = new ArrayList<>(vn);
        for (int i = 0; i < vn; i++) {
            edges.add(new HashMap<>());
        }

        char[][] buf = new char[n][n];
        // read first n lines and set edge[0]
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                buf[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                if (buf[i][j] > '0' && buf[i][j] <= '9') {
                    int key = enc(i, j, 0, n);
                    edges.get(0).put(key, buf[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        // read second n lines into buf
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                buf[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
        int[] dy = {0, -1, 0, 1};

        // tox array
        int[][] tox = new int[n][n];
        Queue<int[]> bfsQueue = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = n-1; i >= 0; i--) {
            for (int j = n-1; j >= 0; j--) {
                if (buf[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    tox[i][j] = 0;
                    bfsQueue.add(new int[]{i, j});
                } else {
                    tox[i][j] = m+1;
                }
            }
        }

        // BFS for tox
        while (!bfsQueue.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = bfsQueue.poll();
            int t = tox[cur[0]][cur[1]];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int x = cur[0] + dx[d];
                int y = cur[1] + dy[d];
                if (x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < n && y < n && buf[x][y] != 'Y' && t+1 < tox[x][y]) {
                    tox[x][y] = t+1;
                    bfsQueue.add(new int[]{x, y});
                }
            }
        }

        // build edges
        for (int i = n-1; i >= 0; i--) {
            for (int j = n-1; j >= 0; j--) {
                for (int t = 0; t < m; t++) {
                    if (t < m) { // always true
                        for (int q = 0; q < 4; q++) {
                            int x = i + dx[q];
                            int y = j + dy[q];
                            if (x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < n && y < n && buf[x][y] != 'Y') {
                                int cond = (buf[x][y] > '0' && buf[x][y] <= '9') ? 1 : 0;
                                if (t+1 < tox[x][y] + cond && t < tox[i][j]) {
                                    int fromKey = enc(i, j, t, n);
                                    int toKey = enc(x, y, t+1, n);
                                    edges.get(fromKey).put(toKey, 1000);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if (buf[i][j] > '0' && buf[i][j] <= '9') {
                        int fromKey = enc(i, j, t, n);
                        int toKey = enc(i, j, m, n);
                        edges.get(fromKey).put(toKey, buf[i][j] - '0');
                    }
                }
                if (buf[i][j] > '0' && buf[i][j] <= '9') {
                    int fromKey = enc(i, j, m, n);
                    edges.get(fromKey).put(1, buf[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        int res = 0;
        for (int u = 8; u > 0; u /= 2) {
            res += aug(0, 1, u, edges, vn);
        }
        System.out.println(res);
        sc.close();
    }

    static int enc(int x, int y, int t, int n) {
        return x + y * n + t * n * n + 2;
    }

    static int aug(int s, int t, int cap, ArrayList<HashMap<Integer, Integer>> edges, int vn) {
        int result = 0;
        int[] from = new int[vn];
        int[] flow = new int[vn];
        boolean continueLoop;
        do {
            continueLoop = false;
            for (int i = 0; i < vn; i++) from[i] = -1;
            from[s] = s;
            flow[s] = cap;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int x = q.poll();
                if (x == t) {
                    // augment flow along path
                    int cur = t;
                    while (cur != s) {
                        int prev = from[cur];
                        int old1 = edges.get(prev).get(cur);
                        edges.get(prev).put(cur, old1 - flow[t]);
                        int old2 = edges.get(cur).getOrDefault(prev, 0);
                        edges.get(cur).put(prev, old2 + flow[t]);
                        cur = prev;
                    }
                    result += flow[t];
                    continueLoop = true;
                    break;
                }
                for (Map.Entry<Integer, Integer> e : edges.get(x).entrySet()) {
                    if (e.getValue() >= cap && from[e.getKey()] == -1) {
                        from[e.getKey()] = x;
                        flow[e.getKey()] = Math.min(e.getValue(), flow[x]);
                        q.add(e.getKey());
                    }
                }
            }
        } while (continueLoop);
        return result;
    }
}
